name: common_cte_offset
description: The same +20 ppm/C offset is added to every CTE; mismatch stress must be invariant.

assumptions.axial_reduction: exact mirror symmetry about stack center plane
assumptions.reported_design_value: 99th percentile of epoxy cell-center maximum-principal tensile stress
assumptions.raw_peak_warning: The raw material-corner peak is mesh-sensitive and is reported only as a diagnostic.
